svg.text: dau. of Uzun Hasan, Aq Qoyunlu
Mir Sayyed Mohammad Marashi — grandson of
Suleiman I through his daughter Shahrbanu Begum
puppet of Karim Khan Zand — grandson of Sultan
Three generations of hereditary sheikhs (Sadr al-Din, Khwaja Ali, Ibrahim) are omitted between Safi al-Din and Junayd.
Haydar married his own first cousin: Halime Begum's father Uzun Hasan was the brother of Haydar's mother, Khadija Begum.
From Safi onward every shah was born to a slave concubine rather than a formally married royal wife — Safavid princes no longer married at all.
A third pretender, styled Sultan Husayn II, claimed in 1753 to be a son of Tahmasp II who had escaped the 1725 massacre; the claim was never substantiated.
